scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sdlc-hub/web && npm run build -w @sdlc-hub/cli
scripts.demo: npm run -s build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs demo
scripts.test:gitlab: npm run -s build && HUB_GITLAB_IT=1 vitest run packages/install/test/gitlab.int.test.ts
scripts.test:github: npm run -s build && HUB_GITHUB_IT=1 vitest run packages/install/test/github.int.test.ts
scripts.sample: npm run -s build && node scripts/sample.mjs && node scripts/screenshots.mjs
